faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Senior Project Assistant - Research recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Senior Project Assistant - Research post at IIT Kharagpur is 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Senior Project Assistant - Research position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Senior Project Assistant - Research position at IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with 2 years of experience or a Graduate degree in Mechanical Engineering with 1 year of experience.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Physically handicapped/Visually Handicapped candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Assistant - Research role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is up to Rs. 30,600 per month, plus HRA, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official IIT Kharagpur website before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Senior Project Assistant - Research position is Temporary.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Kharagpur located?
faq.answer: IIT Kharagpur is located in Kharagpur, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is IIT/SRIC/R/IRNO/2026/102.
